Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients admitted  [AND] in the non-critical areas of the Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Médicas y Nutrición Salvador Zubirán (INCMNSZ) with a nutritional risk between January 2019 and July 2020 will be considered eligible

right.raw_text: -  Patients with recent diagnosis of IF type II (an evolution >28 days) originate from various gastrointestinal  [OR] or systemic diseases (short bowel, [OR]  intestinal fistula, [OR]  intestinal dysmotility, [OR]  mechanical obstruction, [OR]  and extensive small bowel mucosal disease)

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with contraindications for PN
  -  Patients with known allergies to the components of the PN formula
  -  Severe liver  [OR] or renal insufficiency
  -  Uncontrolled diabetes mellitus
  -  Certain acute  [OR] and life-threatening conditions
  -  Immunological diseases (such as autoimmune diseases, [OR]  human immunodeficiency virus infection, [OR]  cancer, etc

right.raw_text:
)
  -  Those that take immunosuppressant medications
  -  Severe hemorrhagic disorders
  -  Pregnant  [OR] or lactating
